title: Canonical arrow-indexed product transitions and cocycle
statement: Let J be a small category, F : J → Cat a functor, T_j topologies with every F(a) continuous [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and A_j abelian sheaves. Put R_a = F(a)_* and B_j = ∏_{t:j→l} R_t A_l. Let c_ab : R_a R_b ≅ R_ab be the canonical comparison induced by F.map_comp. There are maps q_a : B_j → R_a B_k such that q_a R_a(π_t) = π_(a≫t) c_(a,t)^(-1) for every outgoing t from k, and q_(a≫b) = q_a R_a(q_b) c_ab for every composable a,b. No sheaves Fs, augmentation maps, or compatibility with them are assumed or asserted.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EXZ proof, canonical transition components, adjoint form

proof.text: Continuous pushforward R_a preserves products: it is a right adjoint, since abelian-group sheaves on small sites admit sheafification. Use the preserved product universal property to define q_a with the prescribed projections. These equations determine q_a uniquely.

For composable a,b, test both sides of the cocycle after each mapped projection. Naturality of c_ab moves the projection through the comparison. Both composites select the factor indexed by a≫b≫t; associativity identifies the indices. The comparison maps agree because they are transports along F.map_comp and both underlying presheaf maps transport along the same equality of composite functors. Thus the preserved product universal property gives the cocycle.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_arrow_product_transitions_cocycle
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J]
    (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u}) (T : ∀ j : J, GrothendieckTopology (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (T j) (T k)]
    (A : ∀ j : J, Sheaf (T j) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    let R := fun {j k : J} (a : j ⟶ k) ↦
      (F.map a).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (T j) (T k)
    let B := fun j ↦ ∏ᶜ fun t : Σ k : J, j ⟶ k ↦ (R t.2).obj (A t.1)
    ∃ (q : ∀ {j k : J} (a : j ⟶ k), B j ⟶ (R a).obj (B k)),
      (∀ {j k : J} (a : j ⟶ k) (t : Σ l : J, k ⟶ l),
        q a ≫ (R a).map (Pi.π _ t) =
          Pi.π _ ⟨t.1, a ≫ t.2⟩ ≫
            (Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuousComp'
              (eqToIso (congrArg Cat.Hom.toFunctor (F.map_comp a t.2).symm))
              AddCommGrpCat.{u} (T j) (T k) (T t.1)).inv.app (A t.1)) ∧
      (∀ {j k l : J} (a : j ⟶ k) (b : k ⟶ l),
        q (a ≫ b) = q a ≫ (R a).map (q b) ≫
          (Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuousComp'
            (eqToIso (congrArg Cat.Hom.toFunctor (F.map_comp a b).symm))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u} (T j) (T k) (T l)).hom.app (B l))
